headline: Bus burned, crude bombs explode in multiple Dhaka areas
summary: A parked bus was set on fire in Kafrul, while crude bombs detonated in Jatrabari, Malibagh, and Mohakhali, leaving one person injured.
details: A parked bus was set on fire in front of the Kafrul Police Station on Thursday night around 10:00 pm. Sub-Inspector Zahirul Islam confirmed there were no casualties in the bus fire incident.
caption:
A bus set ablaze and crude bombs exploding across Dhaka. Chaos in the capital.

headline_marked: Over 10,000 [[dengue cases reported in Khulna Division]] as hospitals overflow
headline: Over 10,000 dengue cases reported in Khulna Division as hospitals overflow
summary: Medical facilities are struggling to cope with a surge in patients, with risks remaining high as October looms.
details: Dengue cases in the Khulna Division have surpassed 10,000, putting immense pressure on the healthcare system.
Hospitals are currently overwhelmed by the capacity of patients seeking treatment for the virus.
Health officials warn that the risk of infection remains significant as the month of October approaches.
The surge in cases has led to overcrowding in medical facilities, making it difficult to manage the influx of patients.
caption:
